Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activity rows against target CHEMBL5145. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606, standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value is not null. Do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id.
